Submit contributions to this repository through a GitHub pull request.

## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and how this change addresses it. Link related issues.

## Validation

List the commands and results. Explain checks you could not run and why.

## Checklist

- [ ] I followed the [contribution guide](https://github.com/kicksideai/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and any repository-specific instructions.
- [ ] Relevant build and lint checks pass.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior; SQLite and PostgreSQL checks pass where relevant to persistence or migrations (or I explained why a backend does not apply).
- [ ] UI source and regenerated tracked served assets are included together, where applicable.
- [ ] Documentation and links describe the resulting behavior accurately.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, or generated local runtime state are included.
- [ ] The [CLA](https://github.com/kicksideai/.github/blob/main/CLA.md) check passes, or my GitHub account is already recorded or allowlisted.
